concept: Grand vintage-theater opulence: a deep velvet-burgundy primary and ornate antique-gold accent set against warm cream and near-black ink, evoking the nostalgic drama of a historic St. Charles marquee at showtime.
contrastNotes: All ratios computed per WCAG 2.1. ink #1A1410 on bg #FBF5EA = 16.81:1 (>=7). ink-soft #5C4F40 on bg = 7.31:1 (>=4.5). white on primary #7A1228 = 10.8:1 (>=4.5). primary on bg = 9.95:1 (>=3). accent #C9962B on near-black #000 = 7.88:1 (>=3) for bright pop on dark heroes. Bonus: white on primary-dark = 14.97:1, white on secondary #3A2150 = 13.88:1, ink on surface = 17.67:1, ink on surface-alt = 14.88:1, secondary on bg = 12.79:1. Note: gold accent is a decorative/dark-hero pop (2.46:1 on cream) and is not used as body text on the light bg.
